title: Real Research Today: Shape-Shifting Apparel
definition: Today's documented research behind Shape-Shifting Apparel.
description:
The road to Shape-Shifting Apparel is already being paved. Digital fashion (DressX, The Fabricant) sells clothes that exist only on avatars. Mycelium leather (Bolt Threads Mylo, Ecovative) and lab leather reach products.

Generative art (Refik Anadol, Sougwen Chung) fills museums with AI-driven works. Together these programs form the shape alloys foundation that Shape-Shifting Apparel will build on — the apparel logistics results, the actuation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as apparel logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Shape-Shifting Apparel
definition: Estimates Shape-Shifting Apparel readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Shape-Shifting Apparel components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a apparel hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Shape-Shifting Apparel operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where shape alloys monitoring, apparel logistics redundancy, or actuation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Shape-Shifting Apparel Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Shape-Shifting Apparel: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Shape-Shifting Apparel — clothes reshaping to occasion.

Phase 1 — Prove (shape alloys): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (apparel logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (actuation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (comfort): apparel hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and fashion-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
